stem: A teenager presents with delayed puberty and anosmia. Which named condition is most closely associated with this presentation?
explanation: Kallmann syndrome is the condition most closely associated with delayed puberty and anosmia.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because Kallmann syndrome classically causes hypogonadotropic hypogonadism with anosmia or hyposmia.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because Turner syndrome causes primary gonadal failure in girls and is not classically associated with anosmia.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because Klinefelter syndrome causes primary testicular failure in boys and is not associated with anosmia.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because septo-optic dysplasia can cause pituitary hormone deficiencies, but anosmia is not the key association here.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because mumps orchitis can cause testicular damage and delayed puberty, but it is not associated with anosmia.
